column1: # RTD2142 stock firmware (17eea728...d802): names for code and XDATA, for Ghidra.
# Apply with research/ghidra/RenameSymbols.java; rtd2142_map.REGISTERS is added on top.
# Columns: bank (0-7, or * for every bank), space (CODE or EXTMEM), address (hex), name, note.
# A trailing "_q" in a name marks a role inferred from one use site and not yet confirmed.

column5: MOV DPTR,#target; LJMP here: call target in bank 0
writes 0 to XDATA FFFF (bank register), RET into target
Keil C51 ?C?CCASE: switch on A, table of (hi,lo,value) after the LCALL

column1: # --- 0x35 debug interface (I2C slave over DP AUX; code shared by every bank) ---

column5: EX1 handler: cmd byte from FF24, data bytes from FF25 into E28C..
switch on E28B, see research notes for the table
low nibble 1/2: addr hi; 3/6: write data; 5: autoinc; 0: indirect
first byte of the I2C write (sub-address)
byte written by 0x3B; block length for 0xBA/0xBB
byte returned by an I2C read from 0x35
bit1 start/sub received, bit2 data in, bit4 stop

column1: # --- DP TX1 (the DP output port; TX0 is unused by this firmware) ---

column5: timing words BBB7..BBC6, then MISC0/1, then the VSC colorimetry decision
re-evaluates MISC and the VSC colorimetry slot on a format change
MISC0 bpc/format/colorimetry and MISC1 from DF2D/DF2E/DF2F
BC00 bits 5 and 3 from the forwarded HDR/other SDPs
BBB6 bit 6 = 1 (colorimetry carried in the VSC SDP)
DF2F[6:3]; 0x0D gates the VSC colorimetry path
DF25[7:6]; bit 6 also gates the VSC colorimetry path
VSC DB16..18 from DF2D (pixel encoding) and DF2E (extended colorimetry)
type 7: VSC (HB2/HB3 05/13 when colorimetry is 0x0D, else 01/01); type 0x0D: HDR metadata 0x87
payload through BC8B/BC8C, slot select BC8D

column1: # --- DP RX stream 1 (VRR groundwork; roles not yet confirmed) ---

column5: writes DPF_CTRL_0 (B130: only disp_en is ever set) and DP_RSV1 (B191)
disp_en off + dpf_reset, B141-B150 timing and B133-B137 frame-sync offsets from the MSA, then B130 &= 0x4F (full-last-line mode)
